title: FunctionalityDefinitionState
description: One managed definition as a Worker sees it: its origin, desired enabledness, and current preparation outcome. Credentials never appear.

state.description: disabled: available, model-invisible. active: enabled and prepared. unavailable: enabled but preparation has an exact Problem. authorization-required: enabled and awaiting a protocol continuation.

detail.description: Family-owned presentation facts about an active definition (a server's protocol version and tool names, an agent card summary). Never credentials, never authority.
